experiment: CSI300 follow-up: execution label, economic representation, rolling refits
classification: development walk-forward; 2021-2026 outcomes have been inspected in v1, not a virgin holdout
data: reuse unchanged research/data frozen Tencent OHLCV snapshots, end 2026-08-31
evaluation_anchors: exactly the 272 v1 adaptive_normalized Friday anchors, 2021-01-08 through 2026-08-21
quality: keep calendar rows; exclude training observations whose 125 input bars, close label interval, or execution label interval contain flagged invalid OHLC bars
execution_label: open after next observed same-weekday signal / open after current signal - 1; for evaluated Fridays this is exactly next Friday rebalance open-to-open
daily_training: all weekdays; next same weekday creates analogous weekly open-to-open labels; all label endpoints must be observed by training cutoff
paired_training_samples: close-return and execution-return arms share the intersection of completed, valid close and execution labels
close_label: close[t+5]/close[t]-1; bridge arm separating direct-return target from v1 normalized-price target
validation: rolling simulation 2018-01-01 to 2020-12-31; validation labels must end by 2020-12-31; tune only here
regularization: min mean squared loss + lambda*||coef||^2; n-scaled penalty for comparable strength across window sizes
lambda_selection: lowest validation execution-return RMSE for ridge; lowest validation log loss for logistic; ties favor stronger penalty
pipeline_selection: lowest validation execution-return RMSE among economic/multiscale/adaptive ridge candidates, excluding legacy patch arms; freeze before development predictions are evaluated
legacy_features: unchanged v1 normalized-adaptive 700-coordinate patch representation, using saved annual P0; validation uses saved pre-2018 P0
economic_base: 75 coordinates: last 5 candles x 8 economic channels plus 7 summaries at lengths 5/10/20/60/125
economic_channels: log volume relative to trailing <=20 bars inside window
boundary: first input bar's return and gap set to zero because preceding close is outside 125-bar window; volume average uses only currently observed prefix within the window
economic_summaries: current log close minus trailing mean log close
multiscale: append 4 statistics (sum returns, return std, mean range, mean relative log volume) for right-aligned fixed 5/10/20-day partitions: 180 coordinates; total 255
economic_adaptive: append 4 economic statistics plus duration/end-position/valid mask for <=25 annual-P0 adaptive-normalized segments: 175 coordinates; total 250
prototype_schedule: legacy and economic-adaptive arms use unchanged v1 annual prototypes for 2021+; fixed pre-2018 prototype during validation; other arms do not use P0
quarterly_cutoff: last calendar day before quarter; all training label endpoints <= cutoff
feature_scaler: training rows only per refit; constants sd=1; no test clipping or normalization fitted on test distribution
probability_comparator: L2 logistic regression on multiscale features, expanding annual and rolling-5y quarterly; position p_up>0.5; forecast return uses p_up*training_mean_up + (1-p_up)*training_mean_nonup
execution: same v1 next-open, persistent long/cash positions, terminal liquidation 2026-08-31; price-index proxy with hypothetical one-way friction
threshold_diagnostic: validation-selected ridge pipeline only, fixed entry thresholds 0/10/20/40 bps; set long iff predicted return exceeds threshold; no test-selected threshold
inference: paired moving-block bootstrap; all improvement claims exploratory; Holm-adjust mean-squared-error p-values across prespecified ridge comparisons
scope: complete proposed next round of target/feature/training ablations plus probability and threshold diagnostics; no new price downloads, no pretrained Kronos/Crossformer, no account or deployment actions
